events.text: Herod the Great rules for Rome and rebuilds the temple.
Jesus is crucified and rises (about AD 30).
The church spreads from Jerusalem to Gentile cities; Paul is arrested in Jerusalem (about AD 57).
Revolt against Rome from AD 66; the temple destroyed in AD 70.
Ephesus is a leading city of Roman Asia, home to the great temple of Artemis; Nero becomes emperor in AD 54.
A year of civil war, then Vespasian.
Written from prison, about AD 60 to 62 (if by Paul)

teaser.title: Paul in Ephesus
teaser.text: Paul spends about three years teaching in Ephesus (Acts 19), about AD 52 to 55.

teaser.title: Ephesians is written
teaser.text: Paul is a prisoner, probably in Rome, about AD 60 to 62.

teaser.title: The letter is carried
teaser.text: Tychicus carries it, along with the letter to Colossae (Colossians 4:7-8).

review.note: Hand-written first draft from general knowledge. Check against commentaries and a lexicon.
